scope: Source and physical contact are independent. Counts exclude invisible shafts and self-loops; sameDockAndRayPairs require same terminal and same unit arrival direction to 5 decimals for distinct sources, within targets whose source outgoing destination sets differ somewhere. Includes typed endpoint and route labels, not general common paint or interpreted transfer attribution. Primary-only uses retained route class, not same-side source ray. Numeric graph results come solely from already emitted geometry.
